[0, 1] so tolerances are tight — any drift past 1e-4 on the final
probability can flip a chunk-level VAD decision.
Tolerances are conservative first-pass estimates. Calibrate empirically
by running the first reference vs C++ comparison and tightening:
3. Run compare (reports observed max_abs / mean_abs per tensor)
